confidence_notes: Food anchors rest on aggregator and national-average figures, with Sicily-wide and Rome/Turin data adjusted to Catania. Beer and cocktail are extrapolated from Rome/Turin venue data, and the four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings. EUR-to-USD uses an assumed rate of about 1.15, not a sourced one. The FX observation is the latest RBA figure I could verify (20 March 2026), not the generation-date observation, so it is stale.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a mid-sized Sicilian city below Rome and Turin. Restaurant meals use Catania aggregator estimates and a Sicily-wide Numbeo lunch figure. Coffee uses the Italian national espresso average (about EUR 1.29) with a cappuccino uplift. Beer and cocktail use Rome and Turin venue estimates, discounted for Catania. Accommodation uses general knowledge of July rates in Sicilian cities.
